products.name: Coufidou Prunes, 450g
products.tagline: Agen Prunes Stuffed with Prunes Mousse
products.description: The stuffed Prunes of Agen (Pruneaux d’Agen Fourrés) are a classic holiday delicacy, ranking as one of the most prestigious gifts in France. Splendid, full-bodied Agen Prunes are pitted, dried, gently rehydrated, and—delight of delights—filled generously with a smooth purée of their own fruit, delicately flavored with lemon peel and vanilla. Perfect as a sweet foil to cooked game, as a succulent side to foie gras, or served with Armagnac or Banyuls wine at the end of a meal. These prunes also pair beautifully with a cup of Mariage Frères tea for an afternoon treat. Each round tin contains 12 prunes filled with prune mousse.

products.name: Il Cassero Panforte Bianco, 250g
products.description: Il Cassero panforte is a dense, traditional Tuscan "strong bread" that has a long history in Tuscany.t is full of nuts, spices, candied fruits, and honey. Pairs well with an aged pecorino or a glass of Vin Santo!

products.name: Il Cassero Panforte Chocolate & Cherry, 250g
products.description: Il Cassero panforte is a dense, traditional Tuscan "strong bread" that has a long history in Tuscany. It is full of nuts, spices, candied fruits, and honey, while also featuring chocolate and cherries. Pairs very well with Vin Santo!

products.name: Il Cassero Panforte Trio, 300g
products.description: Il Cassero panforte is a dense, traditional Tuscan "strong bread" that has a long history in Tuscany. Can't decide on one flavor? How about a small sampling of each! This pack comes with the classic, fig & chocolate, and a savory version with black pepper.

products.name: La Florentine Assorted Torrone, 18pc
products.description: This soft nougat candy has been a mainstay at DeLaurenti for generations. Although this candy is commonly found in the toe of your stocking on Christmas, it is available here at our store the other 364 days of the year as well. Prepared with the finest crunchy almonds, smooth golden honey, pure cane sugar and fluffy egg whites, it will transport you back to your childhood. Each box contains eighteen individually packaged candies - 6 orange, 6 lemon and 6 vanilla.

products.name: Fabbri Amarena Cherries in Syrup, 120g
products.tagline: The Classic Amarena Cherry in Syrup!
products.description: The Fabbri Company of Bologna has been making uniquely delicious cherries in amarena syrup for over a century. Only the best wild cherries are carefully selected and candied in amarena syrup according to Gennaro Fabbri's original recipe, created in 1905. Eat them straight out of the crock, add them to cobblers and cakes, or top a perfect bowl of vanilla ice cream.

products.name: Antonio Mattei Almond Biscotti, 250g
products.description: Since 1858, Antonio Mattei has been producing Italian biscotti and confections in their historical bakery and shop located on Via Ricasoli, in the heart of the old city of Prato, Tuscany. The bakery has been run by the Pandolfini family for 3 generations. Throughout Tuscany, these biscotti are considered the standard-bearer. Their size, texture and taste are synonymous with quality and tradition. Made only with flour, farm fresh eggs which impart a golden yellow color, sugar, almonds, and pine nuts. Traditionally enjoyed at the end of a meal with a glass of Vin Santo, they are also perfect with coffee, gelato or panna cotta.

products.name: Lazzaroni Amaretti di Saronno Amaretti Snaps, 7oz
products.description: From the folks that know their amaretti. These cookies are crisp and snappy as the name would suggest. A perfet compliment to a bowl of vanilla gelato/ice cream, or crumbled on the top of your tiramisu for a amaretti-filled crunchy victory!

products.description: Since 1718, the Lazzaroni family has crafted amaretti cookies according to their family's traditional recipe. Individually wrapped in pairs with their distinctive paper, these crisp and airy cookies are perfect with coffee, wine or after dinner liqueurs.

products.name: Rinati Brigidini, 200g
products.description: Since the late 1800s, Rinati has been producing the classic Brigidino following the traditional Tuscan recipe. They are crisp and not too sweet with a unique aniseed aroma. If you have a nonna, you have seen her eating these.

products.name: Rinati Cialde de Montecatini, 225g
products.description: These Cialde di Montecatini (waffles of Montecatini) are a Tuscan specialty perfectly suited for coffee, gelato or cocktails! Old school confection at it's best.These aren't your I-hop waffles folks. They are 2 thin, crisp wafers sandwiching a thin layer of not too sweet crumbly almond paste. They will crumble, but then you will pick up all the crumbles and enjoy eating them.
